title: 第一卷 第13章 镇海堂副堂主
novel_title: 津门武圣，从苦力开始每日结算
content_zh:
半小时后，百乐门大厅。

    原本昏暗的灯光全部打开，亮如白昼。

    一张紫檀木大桌摆在正中央，上面点着两根儿臂粗的红蜡烛，烛光摇曳。

    桌后摆着关二爷的像，香炉里插着三炷清香，烟雾缭绕。

    赵海柱换了一身干净的对襟褂子，左手缠着厚厚的绷带，吊在脖子上。

    他右手端着一碗殷红的血酒，神色肃穆。

    在他身后，海河帮的几位头目一字排开，刀疤脸站在最前面，低眉顺眼，大气不敢出。

    陆川站在对面，神色依旧淡然。

    他对这种江湖仪式没什么感觉，但既然答应了入伙，流程还是要走的。

    “今日，我赵海柱与陆川兄弟结为异姓兄弟！”

    赵海柱声音洪亮，中气十足，完全看不出刚才被人一拳打废的样子。

    “从此以后，有福同享，有难同当！”

    “若有违背，天打雷劈，五马分尸！”

    说完，赵海柱仰头将血酒一饮而尽，啪的一声摔碎酒碗。

    陆川也同样饮下血酒，反手将酒碗摔碎。

    “好！”

    周围的帮众齐声喝彩。

    赵海柱放下碗，从怀里掏出一块黑铁令牌，双手递给陆川。

    “陆兄弟，既然进了海河帮，那就是自家兄弟。”

    “按照帮规，新人入帮，得从底层做起。”

    刀疤脸在一旁听得暗暗点头。

    这就对了。

    就算你身手再好，也不能一来就骑在大家头上。

    帮主这是给你面子，没让你去码头扛大包，已经是很看得起你了。

    赵海柱话锋一转，眼神变得锐利起来。

    “但是！规矩是死的，人是活的！”

    “陆兄弟身手盖世，乃是难得一见的练武奇才，更是我海河帮的贵人！”

    “经帮里几位叔伯商量决定，破格提拔陆兄弟，直接担任‘镇涛堂’副堂主！”

    此言一出，全场哗然。

    刀疤脸眼珠子差点瞪出来。

    镇涛堂？

    那可是海河帮的拳头，是专门负责打架杀人的精锐堂口！

    副堂主？

    那是帮里的一人之下，万人之上啊！

    这哪是入伙，这简直是请了个祖宗回来！

    陆川接过令牌，触手冰凉，沉甸甸的。

    “镇涛堂是干什么的？”陆川问了一句。

    赵海柱嘿嘿一笑，指了指门外停着的一艘挂着海河帮旗帜的大船。

    “镇涛堂，就是帮里的主战精锐。”

    “专门负责护航、械斗、镇压叛乱。”

    “简单来说，就是帮里打架最狠、杀人最多的一帮人。”

    “以后，这帮人归你带。”

    陆川点了点头。

    打架？

    他在行。

    “行，我接了。”

    ......

    夜色渐深。

    一辆黑色的福特轿车驶离了百乐门，穿过繁华的租界区，停在了英租界边缘的一栋小洋楼前。

    这地方环境清幽，周围都是些外国领事馆和富商的别墅。

    红砖青瓦，带个小花园，还有独立的院墙和铁门。

    跟猪笼巷那个连耗子都嫌弃的窝棚相比，简直就是天上地下。

    “陆先生，以后这就是您的住处了。”

    刀疤脸也就是张宏，一脸谄媚地打开车门。

    他在海河帮的身份是岸桩堂的副堂主，主管码头管控、装卸苦力、货栈管理、陆路接驳等。

    也是实权的职位，手底下的人手有近千号。

    不过在陆川一番大发神威下，张宏瞬间秒怂。

    按照他的话说就是，大丈夫有所为有所不为。

    找死的事情，他不为。
content_en:
Half an hour later, Paramount Hall.

    All the originally dim lights were turned on, making it as bright as day.

    A large rosewood table was placed in the center, with two arm-thick red candles lit on it, and the candlelight flickered.

    Behind the table is a portrait of Mr. Guan Er. There are three sticks of incense sticks in the incense burner, and the smoke is lingering.

    Zhao Haizhu changed into a clean double-breasted gown, and his left hand was wrapped in a thick bandage and hung around his neck.

    He was holding a bowl of bright red blood wine in his right hand with a solemn expression.

    Behind him, several leaders of the Haihe Gang lined up, with Scarface standing at the front, his eyebrows lowered and his arrogance not daring to show off.

    Lu Chuan stood opposite, his expression still calm.

    He didn't feel much about this kind of martial arts ritual, but since he agreed to join the gang, the process still had to go through.

    "Today, I, Zhao Haizhu, and brother Lu Chuan become brothers with different surnames!"

    Zhao Haizhu's voice was loud and full of energy, and he didn't look like he had just been beaten with a punch.

    "From now on, we will share blessings and share hardships!"

    "If there is any violation, the sky will strike with thunder and five horses will divide the body into pieces!"

    After saying that, Zhao Haizhu raised his head and drank the blood wine in one gulp, then smashed the wine bowl into pieces.

    Lu Chuan also drank the blood wine and broke the wine bowl with his backhand.

    "Okay!"

    The surrounding gang members cheered in unison.

    Zhao Haizhu put down the bowl, took out a black iron token from his arms, and handed it to Lu Chuan with both hands.

    "Brother Lu, since he has joined the Haihe Gang, he is his brother."

    "According to gang rules, new members who join the gang must start from the bottom."

    Scarface listened and nodded secretly.

    That's right.

    No matter how good you are, you can't just ride on everyone's head.

    The gang leader is giving you face by not letting you go to the dock to carry the big bag. He already thinks highly of you.

    Zhao Haizhu changed the topic and his eyes became sharp.

    "But! Rules are dead, people are alive!"

    "Brother Lu is extremely skilled and is a rare martial arts prodigy. He is also a noble member of our Haihe Gang!"

    "After discussion with several uncles in the gang, we decided to promote Brother Lu as an exception and directly serve as the deputy head of the 'Zhentao Hall'!"

    As soon as this statement came out, the whole place was in an uproar.

    Scarface's eyes nearly popped out.

    Zhentao Hall?

    That was the fist of the Haihe Gang, an elite gang responsible for fighting and killing people!

    Deputy Hall Master?

    That is inferior to one person in the gang and superior to ten thousand people!

    This is not joining a gang, this is simply inviting an ancestor back!

    Lu Chuan took the token, his tentacles were cold and heavy.

    "What does Zhentao Hall do?" Lu Chuan asked.

    Zhao Haizhu chuckled and pointed to a large boat parked outside the door with the flag of the Haihe Gang.

    "Zhen Tao Tang is the main combat elite of the gang."

    "Specialized in escorting, fighting, and suppressing rebellions."

    "To put it simply, they are the group of people who fight the most and kill the most."

    "From now on, this group of people will be yours to lead."

    Lu Chuan nodded.

    fight?

    He's good at it.

    "Okay, I'll take it."

    ...

    The night is getting darker.

    A black Ford sedan drove away from Paramount, passed through the bustling concession area, and stopped in front of a small western-style building on the edge of the British Concession.

    The place has a quiet environment, surrounded by foreign consulates and villas of wealthy businessmen.

    It has red bricks and blue tiles, a small garden, an independent courtyard wall and an iron gate.

    Compared to the shack in Pig Cage Alley that even the rats despised, it was like heaven and earth.

    "Mr. Lu, this will be your residence from now on."

    Scarface, also known as Zhang Hong, opened the car door with a flattering look on his face.

    His identity in the Haihe Gang is the deputy leader of the Anzhuang Hall, in charge of terminal control, loading and unloading coolies, warehouse management, land connections, etc.

    It is also a position of real power, with nearly a thousand people under his command.

    However, under Lu Chuan's powerful display, Zhang Hong was instantly frightened.

    According to what he said, a real man has things to do and things he doesn't do.

    He would not seek death.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 13 Deputy Hall Master of Zhenhai Hall
